purpose: Test whether the pinned base teacher can recover from student-generated training-only no-edit states under equal remaining budgets; this is not an independent model-quality evaluation.
hypothesis: Verified teacher continuations from actual student states may add repair and recovery supervision missing from successful teacher-only trajectories; no causal mechanism or improvement asserted.

task_selection.selection: Within repository sort SHA256(UTF8(026-recovery-pilot-v1 + literal NUL + task_id)); round-robin sorted repositories until 48. No outcome filtering.

paired_state.eligibility: Completed third feedback boundary, no source modification in the first three calls, no submit, remaining actor budget positive, all generation accounted.
paired_state.snapshot: Full actor-visible filesystem content and complete visible message history; immutable content manifest and source/feedback digests. No reference snapshot or hidden checks in actor sandbox.
paired_state.guard: same explicit submission verification rule for both branches
paired_state.branch_order: alternate teacher-first/student-first by preselected task index, snapshot each once; preserve both attempts
paired_state.early_completed_or_edited_tasks: Retain student outcome and costs; no teacher branch; never claim them as complete pairs.

budget.branch_remaining_actor_seconds: 600 minus actual shared-prefix actor seconds, excluding backend loading

scoring.primary: On complete eligible pairs: fresh independent grader success within the same remaining actor/call/token caps; no edit and wrong edit remain failures.
scoring.qualified_continuation: Actual teacher-generated source change, fresh standalone exact regression on final source, explicit submit, independent grader pass, complete request/tool/encoding audit; all teacher targets retained without truncation.
scoring.gate_meaning: Pilot feasibility for larger training-data collection, not statistical proof of general coding improvement or permission to release weights.

before_gpu_execution: Implement and test exact live snapshot/restore and two-branch budget accounting.
Run CPU isolation and failure-injection checks.
Freeze source/data/code/model/profile hashes and full execution order in a launch protocol.
Publish executable protocol, verify public bytes and successful CI, then start one supervised run on an idle GPU.
